title: Tamihi Meadows

services.name: 🏠 View Cabins
services.desc: Tiny, rustic, and full of character - six unique glamping cabins on the Chilliwack River Except The Waddle On Inn (which has very basic electricity & the option of an indoor porta potty), all cabins have NO ELECTRICITY, NO WIFI, NO BEDDING, NO RUNNING WATER, AND NO INDOOR PLUMBING. All cabins are very small and have comfortable beds, a small table and chair set, a wood stove that you can cook on, and an outdoor fire pit. The fishermen's cabins and The Waddle On Inn also have a futon in the common room. services.name: 🐴 Horses & Wildlife
services.desc: Our horses free-range - they're calm and gentle but can startle. Interaction at your own risk. No mauling, slapping, or rough handling. If you bring treats: apples must be cut (choking hazard!), no sugar, and use a container - not the ground or by hand.This is true wilderness with lots of wildlife. Keep kids close.
